positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Primary IT Tech Lead to Legal Division for in-house implementation of external applications
•	IT Specific Support for Legal Division’s own eDiscovery and ESI Support Team 
•	Primary Support to upgrade and support customization within legal management platform Mitratech TeamConnect
•	Tech Lead for on premise implementation, maintenance, and support COTS indexing and analytic solution Nuix for eDiscovery work
•	Implement and maintain SaaS product (Zapproved Legal Hold Pro) that automates legal hold management, chosen to replace in-house manual process (Autonomy Legal Hold)
•	Tech Lead for migration from an in-house Freddie Mac email archive solution to cloud based-based solution Smarsh
•	Tech Lead for migration of in-house, SharePoint-based DMS solution and LAN storage structure to cloud-based solution iManage
•	Tech Lead for converting 150 TB of proprietary archived emails into a format for ingestion by a new email archive solution; created subsequent legally definable documentation of process
•	Scripted solution to capture employee information and email addresses to be maintained after employee termination
•	Implemented and maintain trade supplement template solution to publish time sensitive trade supplements to meet SEC standards – preventing $24,000 penalty per violation
•	Represent and lead efforts for Compliance, Corporate, and Legal applications (~55 applications) per Information Security department directives on vulnerability and security standard compliancy
•	Serve as IT Admin for COTS/SaaS products and first level of support of all Legal Department users and their apps – including Coordinators, General Counsel, and Litigation customers
•	Serve as liaison between Legal Directors and IT side of house to streamline necessary directives
•	Navigate through Project Management Deployment Methodologies for application maintenance and deployments
•	Implement new SSL certificates and alter cipher compliance for existing applications

positions.title: Systems Integrator, Professional
positions.description:
•	Tech Lead and SME for eDiscovery application
•	Tech Lead and SME for Debt Pricing Supplements application
•	Configure and maintain project environments comprised of Linux OS, WebLogic, Oracle, and network junctions
•	Work extensively with IBM Rational ClearCase for code version control, IBM Rational ClearQuest for defect tracking, and BMC Remedy 
•	Responsible for integrating Commercial Off The Shelf products with Freddie Mac's system
•	Serve as team Point of Contact on production deployments, creating Implementation Plans and validating deployments

positions.title: Business Associate - Rotation Program
positions.description:
Served as Project Coordinator for the Delivery Fees Release 2A
Lead weekly status meetings with primary Project Team
Responsible for SDLC Gate Deliverables
Point of Contact for Project's Quality Control Requirements and Reviews

positions.title: Project Manager - Senior Project
positions.description:
Served as Project Manager for Senior Group Project for a Knowledge Retention Project
Led development and demonstration of a working prototype built on Microsoft SharePoint
Led weekly meetings with company stakeholders to discuss and construct business plan and requirement definitions
Created Knowledge Transfer Plan the next steps and five methods to capture knowledge upon project handoff to PPL

positions.title: Business Analyst
positions.description: I worked as a Business Analyst, doing comparisons of our internal costs versus competitors, as well the cost of internal solutions versus external solutions.

positions.title: INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY INTERN
positions.description:
Created on business analysis of Volvo IT's internal Electronic Data Interchange costs versus outside competitors
Presented information to Market and Business Intelligence for CIO Presentations
Assisted on internal audit on Volvo IT customer accounts
Created automated Excel Datasheet for future analyses of Electronic Data Interchange costs
Fashioned Market and Business Intelligence's Service Level Agreement for ad hoc requests
Designed internal SharePoint site to submit, view results, and follow status of such ad hoc requests
